recipe.visualDefinition: A centered full-body portrait of a subject in a dark overcoat, set against a textured, moody background with a strong horizontal magenta light wash. The composition is framed by large, expressive neon-colored handwritten script at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with arms extended horizontally mirroring the light band
High contrast between dark clothing and vibrant magenta/purple backlighting
Fluid, organic script typography contrasting with the structured silhouette of the coat
Atmospheric haze softening the transition between the subject and the textured wall
coreInvariants: Horizontal magenta light beam behind the subject
Hand-drawn script with long, sweeping ascenders and descenders
Muted, desaturated skin tones against high-saturation neon accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-full shot, occupying the central vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright magenta light band directly behind the torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top script, moves down to the face, follows the extended arms outward, and settles on the bottom script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space on the left and right sides, filled with textured shadows and atmospheric light.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (clothing and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant magenta and hot pink (light beam and typography)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted lavender and cool grey (background texture)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark subject and the glowing light; high saturation in the pink tones against a desaturated environment.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary greens or yellows
Limit to a cool-toned palette with warm pink highlights

letterConstructionRules: Extremely elongated flourishes on capital letters
Connected lowercase letters with a slight upward slant
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature oversized loops that extend far above the x-height
Final letters in words trail off into long horizontal strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family script used for both top and bottom to create a frame effect.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the personal, expressive nature of the original

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a person in a black overcoat, arms extended, against a dark grey textured wall. A strong horizontal beam of magenta light glows behind their midsection, creating a hazy atmosphere.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom handwritten script in a neon pink color at the top and bottom of the frame. The script should have long, elegant flourishes and a monolinear stroke.

verificationChecks: Is the magenta light band horizontally aligned?
Does the script have a hand-drawn, fluid quality?
Is the subject's silhouette clearly defined against the glow?
Are the neon colors vibrant against the dark background?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the flourishes
Check that the magenta light doesn't blow out the subject's details
Verify the composition feels balanced and symmetrical
Confirm the color palette remains cohesive
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered moody portrait with a horizontal neon light wash and frame it with expressive, monolinear hand-scripted display text.
